testsuite.name: Test a partial refund on a captured order

testcase.name: S1: Order status is valid after create
S3: Refund status is COMPLETED or PENDING
S6: refund_capture is rejected with a 4xx error
S6: Error body has PayPal 'name' field
S6: PayPal debug_id returned for support tracing (header or body)
S6: Error issue code is REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDED
S7: Refund status is COMPLETED or PENDING
S8: refund_capture is rejected with a 4xx error
S8: Error body has PayPal 'name' field
S8: PayPal debug_id returned for support tracing (header or body)
S8: Error issue code is CAPTURE_FULLY_REFUNDED
S5: Capture status is PARTIALLY_REFUNDED after an 8.00 refund on a 20.00 capture
S4: First refund reports total refunded 8.00
S7: Cumulative total refunded is 20.00 after the 12.00 refund
S9: Capture status is REFUNDED once fully refunded

testsuite.system-out:
Partial refund on a captured order behaves correctly in the PayPal sandbox. A 20.00 USD card-funded order (order 603965450M1249740, capture 1G2950341L0926923) was partially refunded 8.00 (refund 83R28259SF490483K, COMPLETED). The capture moved to PARTIALLY_REFUNDED. An over-refund of 13.00 against 12.00 remaining was rejected with REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDED. A refund of the remaining 12.00 succeeded (refund 8LH69773LF956593X), cumulative total refunded reached 20.00, and the capture became REFUNDED. A further refund attempt was rejected with CAPTURE_FULLY_REFUNDED. All built-in and goal-specific assertions passed.
[INFO] Partial refund flow works as expected: An 8.00 partial refund on a 20.00 capture returned COMPLETED, the capture status changed to PARTIALLY_REFUNDED, and the refund's total_refunded_amount reported 8.00. Verified via S3, S4, S5.
[INFO] Over-refund correctly rejected: Refunding 13.00 when only 12.00 remained returned HTTP 422 with REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDED, as documented.
[INFO] Remaining balance refund and full-refund state correct: Refunding the exact remaining 12.00 succeeded with cumulative total 20.00. The capture then moved to REFUNDED, and a further refund was rejected with CAPTURE_FULLY_REFUNDED.
[INFO] Coverage gaps: Not covered: refunds in a different currency (REFUND_CAPTURE_CURRENCY_MISMATCH), refunds of zero or negative amounts, idempotency via PayPal-Request-Id on retried refunds, refunds on PayPal-wallet (non-card) orders, and the get_order view of refund status. The test also did not check the 'up' order link or the order-level status after refund.
